title: Remote work and federal recruitment
summary: Whether remote eligibility changes the size, geography, composition, and quality of applicant pools—and how workplace flexibility functions as a labor-market amenity.
body_html:
This project studies whether remote eligibility changes the size, geography, composition, and quality of federal applicant pools.

It treats workplace flexibility as a labor-market amenity and links job-posting text, application outcomes, geography, and organizational context.
